```{python}
# Gráfico de puntos
alt.Chart(cars).mark_point().encode(
    x="Weight_in_lbs",
    y="Miles_per_Gallon",
    color="Origin",
    shape="Origin",
    tooltip=["Name","Origin","Miles_per_Gallon","Weight_in_lbs"]
).interactive()
```

```{python}
# Gráfico de barras
alt.Chart(cars).mark_bar().encode(
    x="Origin",
    y="count()"
)
```

```{python}
# Gráfico de líneas
alt.Chart(cars).mark_line().encode(
    alt.X('Year'),
    alt.Y('Weight_in_lbs'),
    alt.Color('Origin')
).properties(
    width=600
).interactive()
```

```{python}
# Gráfico de líneas con promedio
alt.Chart(cars).mark_line(point=True).encode(
    alt.X('Year'),
    alt.Y('mean(Weight_in_lbs)'),
    alt.Color('Origin')
).properties(
    width=600
).interactive()
```
